parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data catalog.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description:
The conditional expression used to filter partitions. Supported operators include the following:

- Comparison operators: =, <>, !=, <, <=, >, >=. Example: ds>20240101.

- Logical operators: AND, OR, NOT. Example: ds LIKE '20240%'

- BETWEEN operator: Specifies a range. Example: ds BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20241201.

- IN operator: Specifies a set of values. Example: ds IN (20240101, 20240102).

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results per page. Maximum: 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next page of results. Values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, no more pages exist.

- If **NextToken** has a value, use it as the starting token for the next request.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.

> Find this ID by hovering over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
